question: Identify the names of cards that meet all of the following criteria: (1) illustrated by either Jeremy Jarvis or Chippy, (2) belong to the set named 'Coldsnap', (3) have an Italian-translated version, and (4) have a convertedManaCost greater than the average convertedManaCost of all cards in the 'Coldsnap' set. Return the results ordered by convertedManaCost in descending order.

prediction.sql:
SELECT c."XCL_049"
FROM cards AS c
INNER JOIN sets AS s ON c."XCL_063" = s."XCL_099"
WHERE s."XCL_110" = 'Coldsnap'
  AND c."XCL_002" IN ('Jeremy Jarvis', 'Chippy')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM foreign_data AS fd
    WHERE fd."XCL_082" = c."XCL_072"
      AND fd."XCL_077" = 'Italian'
  )
  AND c."XCL_011" > (
    SELECT AVG(c2."XCL_011")
    FROM cards AS c2
    INNER JOIN sets AS s2 ON c2."XCL_063" = s2."XCL_099"
    WHERE s2."XCL_110" = 'Coldsnap'
  )
ORDER BY c."XCL_011" DESC

FROM cards AS c
INNER JOIN sets AS s ON c."XCL_063" = s."XCL_099"
WHERE s."XCL_110" = 'Coldsnap'

    SELECT 1

    WHERE fd."XCL_082" = c."XCL_072"

    SELECT AVG(c2."XCL_011")

    WHERE s2."XCL_110" = 'Coldsnap'
  )
ORDER BY c."XCL_011" DESC

entity_grain_realization.pre_realization_sql:
SELECT c."XCL_049"
FROM cards AS c
INNER JOIN sets AS s ON c."XCL_063" = s."XCL_099"
WHERE s."XCL_110" = 'Coldsnap'
  AND c."XCL_002" IN ('Jeremy Jarvis', 'Chippy')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM foreign_data AS fd
    WHERE fd."XCL_082" = c."XCL_072"
      AND fd."XCL_077" = 'Italian'
  )
  AND c."XCL_011" > (
    SELECT AVG(c2."XCL_011")
    FROM cards AS c2
    INNER JOIN sets AS s2 ON c2."XCL_063" = s2."XCL_099"
    WHERE s2."XCL_110" = 'Coldsnap'
  )
ORDER BY c."XCL_011" DESC

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT c."XCL_003"
FROM cards AS c
INNER JOIN sets AS s ON c."XCL_063" = s."XCL_099"
INNER JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON c."XCL_072" = fd."XCL_082"
WHERE s."XCL_110" = 'Coldsnap'
  AND c."XCL_002" IN ('Jeremy Jarvis', 'Chippy')
  AND fd."XCL_077" = 'Italian'
  AND c."XCL_011" > (SELECT AVG(c2."XCL_011") FROM cards AS c2 INNER JOIN sets AS s2 ON c2."XCL_063" = s2."XCL_099" WHERE s2."XCL_110" = 'Coldsnap')
ORDER BY c."XCL_011" DESC
